graph_nodes.name: LabelRanker.prepare
examples: (R-A2L-LIST.072/1) C08 names, generation `1` → a worker on a thread ≠ the UI thread builds an index of `462`; `ready` `True` after `_install`
(R-A2L-LIST.072/2) `[]` (unload), generation `2` → an index of `0`; any request then delivers `[]`
(derived) the same names and generation twice → one build only
graph_nodes.func: new [D-13]. If `generation` equals the generation already prepared or being prepared, return. Else record it, drop the old index (`ready` becomes `False`) and start one thread worker (`app.run_worker(..., thread=True, group="a2l_label_index")`) that calls `build_label_index(names)` and hands the index to `_install` through `app.call_from_thread`. `names` is copied to a tuple on the UI thread before the worker starts.

graph_nodes.name: LabelRanker._install
examples: (R-A2L-LIST.074/1) build held; `0017` requested for "filter" (held); build released → the held request runs and delivers 5 matches (P1 §2)
(derived) generation 1 built after generation 2 was requested → index of 1 dropped, `ready` stays `False`
graph_nodes.func: new. UI thread. If `generation` is not the latest prepared generation, drop the index (a newer A2L won). Else keep it, set `ready`, and re-issue each request held while not ready whose token is still that consumer's latest (R-A2L-LIST.074).

graph_nodes.name: LabelRanker.request
examples: (R-A2L-LIST.073/1) "filter", `cuvre_00`, 20 → `rank` called on a worker thread (thread id ≠ UI thread); `deliver` receives 20 matches, first `CURVE_0001` fuzzy `e1` (P1 §2)
(R-A2L-LIST.073/2) "similar", `MAP_0024`, 3 → `rank` on a worker thread; `deliver` receives `[]` (P1 §4)
(I-3 obligation 6) limit `100` → `rank` called with `20`
graph_nodes.func: new. UI thread. Give the consumer a new token (the latest token per consumer wins). Not ready → hold `(token, query, limit, deliver, current)` for `_install`. Ready → one thread worker runs `rank(query, index, min(limit, 20))` and hands the result to `_deliver` with the token and the generation through `app.call_from_thread`. `rank` never runs on the UI thread.

graph_nodes.name: LabelRanker._deliver
examples: (R-A2L-LIST.071/1) "filter": `cu` requested, then `cuvre_00` requested before `cu`'s result → `cu`'s result dropped; only `cuvre_00`'s 20 matches delivered
(R-A2L-LIST.071/2) a result whose generation `1` arrives after an A2L transition prepared generation `2` → dropped
(R-A2L-LIST.052/1) "similar" result for a text the operator has edited since (`current()` `False`) → dropped, no similar line painted
graph_nodes.func: new. UI thread. Call `deliver(matches)` only when `token` is still the consumer's latest, `generation` is still the prepared generation and `current()` is true (the box or text area still holds the query); otherwise drop the result.
